integrity: Uniform proof with signed Lefschetz traces and an integral chain splitting; independently performed audit or external validation not asserted.
scientific_limitations: Rational dihedral representation for C7[Kq] with q>=2, colors fixed; no integral group-ring classification, other base cycles, or wreath-product action. The nonequivariant homology follows from earlier polyhedral-join literature; equivalent unindexed equivariant work remains possible.
title: Dihedral homology character of the seven-cycle clique-substitution independence complex
